reason: E3 directly supports that Al2O3 forms via selective oxidation of Al in AlCoCrFeNi HEAs, but the cited evidence does not show that Cr or Si enhance Al2O3 formation, nor does it provide a controlled comparison with low-Al HEAs to support the baseline claim. E1 and E5 discuss general oxidation behavior without addressing the specific mechanistic role of Cr and Si in promoting Al2O3.
premises: Selective oxidation of Al forms protective Al2O3 scale in HEAs
Cr and Si enhance the formation of this protective Al2O3 layer
Al2O3 scale acts as a barrier providing oxidation resistance
HEAs without sufficient Al lack oxidation resistance
